bullets.text: Cyclone Murasu uprooted 12 trees and damaged homes and vehicles in Chennai, and the office should monitor ongoing relief operations and weather warnings.
Sun News issued a heavy rain alert for Chennai and Thiruvallur, and the office must coordinate emergency response readiness across both districts.
Sewage vehicle owners protested by parking vehicles at the Gummidipoondi block development office, and the district team should watch for resolution of their grievances.
The Greater Chennai Corporation removed ad skins from 73 illegal hoardings while 43 steel structures remain, and the office should track the removal of remaining frames.
Vultr plans to build 1 GW of AI compute capacity by 2029 placing Chennai at the center, and the portfolio team should support this infrastructure expansion.
Corning expanded Pune optical manufacturing and started its Chennai cover-glass plant, and the office should monitor manufacturing growth for the AI data center market.
Global AI stock sell-offs put Indian IT companies in focus, and the ministry should watch how regional service providers capitalize on shifting investor sentiment.
